title: bedobuntu: Cheetah Dual (Ubuntu + Phosh for Pixel 7 Pro)
description: Scripts and documentation for running Ubuntu 24.04 with Phosh on a Google Pixel 7 Pro (cheetah) alongside Android, with two-way switch helpers and a shared ext4 partition. Idea, design and integration by Abdalla Kamel Mohamed El Afify. To our knowledge, the first public Ubuntu + Phosh port for cheetah with this dual-boot and switch design. Built with the help of Omarchy Mobile, XDA Developers tools and Magisk; dual-boot-on-slots and slot-switch ideas existed before. Not affiliated with Canonical or Google.
